tools.name: provision_postgres_project
tools.description: Provision a new Postgres database. Returns project credentials on success, or payment details if x402 payment is needed.

tier.description: Database tier: prototype ($0.10/7d, free with testnet faucet), hobby ($5/30d), team ($20/30d)

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Execute SQL (DDL or queries) against a provisioned project. Returns results as a markdown table.

project_id.description: The project ID to run SQL against

sql.description: SQL statement to execute (DDL or DML)

tools.name: rest_query
tools.description: Query or mutate data via the PostgREST REST API. Supports GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE with query params.

body.description: Request body for POST/PATCH (JSON object or array)

key_type.description: Which key to use: anon (default, respects RLS) or service (bypasses RLS)

tools.name: apply_expose
tools.description: Apply a declarative authorization manifest to a project (POST /projects/v1/admin/:id/expose). The manifest describes the full authorization surface: tables (with policy, owner_column, force_owner_on_insert, i_understand_this_is_unrestricted, custom_sql), views (with base, select, filter), and rpcs (with signature, grant_to). Convergent: applying the same manifest twice is a no-op; items dropped between applies have their policies/grants/triggers/views revoked. Tables are dark by default — any table not declared with expose:true is unreachable via anon/authenticated.

$schema.description: Optional editor/schema hint for the expose manifest JSON schema

expose.description: true to expose the table; false to hide it (policies + grants revoked on apply)

policy.description: RLS policy template. Required when expose=true. user_owns_rows (users access only their own rows; requires owner_column), public_read_authenticated_write (anyone reads; any authenticated user can write ANY row), public_read_write_UNRESTRICTED (⚠ fully open; requires i_understand_this_is_unrestricted: true), custom (escape hatch; requires custom_sql).

owner_column.description: Column containing the user ID (required for user_owns_rows)

force_owner_on_insert.description: If true, an INSERT trigger sets owner_column to auth.uid() automatically

i_understand_this_is_unrestricted.description: Required to be true when policy is public_read_write_UNRESTRICTED

custom_sql.description: Raw SQL (CREATE POLICY statements) run after RLS is enabled. Required when policy=custom

tables.description: Tables to declare (include everything you want exposed AND anything to drop from a prior manifest). Omitted means an empty section.

base.description: Base table the view reads from

filter.description: Optional SQL WHERE clause applied to the view

security_invoker.description: Always coerced to true on apply (never bypass RLS)

expose.description: Whether to grant SELECT to anon/authenticated (default true)

views.description: Views to declare (typed projections over tables). Omitted means an empty section.

signature.description: Argument list including parens, e.g. "(user_id uuid)" or "()"

grant_to.description: Roles to grant EXECUTE to, e.g. ["authenticated"]

rpcs.description: RPCs (PL/pgSQL functions) to expose with explicit grants. Omitted means an empty section.

manifest.description: Full authorization manifest. Convergent: applying twice is a no-op; items removed between applies are dropped. Tables are dark by default — any table not listed with expose:true is unreachable via anon/authenticated.

tools.name: validate_manifest
tools.description: Validate an auth/expose manifest without applying it. This checks the authorization manifest used by manifest.json, database.expose, and apply_expose; it is not deploy-manifest validation. Optional migration_sql is reference context only and is not executed. Use deploy planning/dry-run surfaces for deploy manifest questions.

anyOf.description: Auth/expose manifest object used by manifest.json, database.expose, and apply_expose.

manifest.description: Auth/expose manifest as a JSON object or JSON string. This is not a deploy manifest.

migration_sql.description: Optional migration SQL used only as reference context for validation; it is not executed.

project_id.description: Optional project id for live-schema validation. Omit for projectless validation.

tools.name: get_expose
tools.description: Get the current authorization manifest for a project (GET /projects/v1/admin/:id/expose). Returns the last-applied manifest from `internal.project_manifest`, or a manifest reconstructed by introspecting live DB state if none has ever been applied. The `source` field is `"applied"` or `"introspected"`.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Introspect the database schema — tables, columns, types, constraints, and RLS policies. Useful for understanding the database structure before writing queries.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get project usage report — API calls, storage usage, limits, and lease expiry.

tools.name: assets_put
tools.description: Upload a blob (file or inline content) to project storage via direct-to-S3. Accepts local_path (any size up to 5 TiB) or content (≤ 1 MB inline). Public blobs get a CDN URL; private blobs require authenticated reads. Use `immutable: true` to produce a content-addressed URL that never needs cache invalidation.

key.description: Destination key (path in the project's blob namespace). No leading slash. Example: 'images/logo.png' or 'circuits/v1.zkey'.

local_path.description: Path to a local file to upload. Mutually exclusive with `content`.

content.description: Inline content to upload (UTF-8 string). For small blobs ≤ 1 MB. Mutually exclusive with `local_path`.

content_type.description: MIME type (auto-detected from file extension if omitted).

visibility.description: Default: public. Public blobs get a CDN URL; private blobs require authenticated reads.

immutable.description: When true, the returned URL includes a content-hash suffix so overwrites produce distinct URLs. CLI auto-computes sha256.

tools.name: assets_get
tools.description: Download a blob to a local file path. Writes bytes directly to disk (no context-window bloat). Returns size + SHA-256 header (if the blob has one stored).

output_path.description: Local filesystem path to write the bytes to. Parent directories will be created.

tools.name: assets_ls
tools.description: List blobs in a project with optional prefix filter over a flat key namespace. Supports pagination via cursor.

prefix.description: Filter: only return blobs whose key starts with this prefix

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor

tools.name: assets_rm
tools.description: Delete a blob from project storage and decrement the project's storage_bytes.

tools.name: assets_sign
tools.description: Generate a time-boxed S3 presigned GET URL for a blob. Use this to share a private blob externally without exposing your apikey. Default TTL 1 hour, max 7 days.

key.description: Blob key to sign a GET URL for

tools.name: diagnose_public_url
tools.description: Returns the live CDN state for a public blob URL (probed once from gateway-us-east-1 — NOT a global view). Use this when a deployed asset shows the wrong version or you suspect cache staleness. The result includes `expectedSha256` (from gateway DB), `observedSha256` (what CloudFront just served), recent `invalidation` status, and a human-readable `hint` with actionable next-steps. The `probeMayHaveWarmedCache: true` field warns that the probe itself populates the cache, so subsequent reads from elsewhere may differ. URLs outside the requesting project return 403; non-`*.run402.com` URLs return 400 unless they're on one of your active custom domains.

project_id.description: Project ID that owns the URL

tools.name: wait_for_cdn_freshness
tools.description: Polls the CDN until a MUTABLE blob URL serves the expected SHA-256, or the timeout elapses. **For mutable URLs only** — for immutable URLs (the `immutableUrl` returned by `assets_put`), no waiting is needed; they're bound to a SHA at upload time and never previously cached. Use this after a re-upload to an existing public mutable key when an end-user-visible URL must reflect the new content before continuing. The probe is single-vantage (us-east-1). On timeout, the tool returns isError=true so an agent can branch into a fallback — typically: switch to the immutableUrl.

project_id.description: Project ID that owns the URL

url.description: Mutable blob URL to poll (e.g. https://app.run402.com/_blob/avatar.png)

sha256.description: Expected hex SHA-256 (from a preceding upload)

tools.name: deploy_function
tools.description: Deploy a serverless function (Node 22) to a project. Handler signature: export default async (req: Request) => Response. The function can `import { db, adminDb, getUser, email, ai } from '@run402/functions'` — auto-bundled by the platform. Additional npm packages are bundled at deploy time when listed in `deps` (bare names resolve to latest; pinned/range specs are honored verbatim; `@run402/functions` and `run402-functions` rejected; max 30 entries; native binaries rejected). The response includes `runtime_version` (the bundled `@run402/functions` version — surface as 'Functions runtime version', never bare 'runtime'), `deps_resolved` (map of dep name → installed concrete version), and an optional top-level `warnings` array (sibling to the function record).

project_id.description: The project ID to deploy the function to

name.description: Function name (URL-safe slug: lowercase, hyphens, alphanumeric, e.g. 'stripe-webhook')

code.description: TypeScript or JavaScript source code. Must export a default async function: export default async (req: Request) => Response

deps.description: Optional npm package specs to install and bundle. Bare names (e.g. 'lodash') resolve to latest at deploy time; pinned (e.g. 'lodash@4.17.21') or range specs ('date-fns@^3.0.0') are honored verbatim. '@run402/functions' (auto-bundled) and 'run402-functions' (legacy name) are rejected. Max 30 entries, max 200 chars per spec. Native binary modules (sharp, canvas, native bcrypt, etc.) are rejected.

schedule.description: Cron expression (5-field, e.g. '*/15 * * * *') to run the function on a schedule. Pass null to remove an existing schedule.

tools.name: invoke_function
tools.description: Invoke a deployed function via HTTP. Returns the function's response body and status code. Useful for testing functions without building a frontend.

tools.name: get_function_logs
tools.description: Get recent logs from a deployed function. Shows console.log/error output and error stack traces from CloudWatch.

name.description: Function name to get logs for

tail.description: Number of log lines to return (default: 50, max: 1000)

since.description: Only return logs at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-03-29T14:00:00Z). Invalid timestamps are rejected before the API call.

request_id.description: Only return logs correlated to this routed/function request id, such as req_abc123.

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List all deployed functions for a project. Shows names, URLs, runtime, timeout, memory, and (for functions deployed under bundling-at-deploy) the Functions runtime version (`@run402/functions` version) and resolved direct deps. Functions deployed before that change have `runtime_version` and `deps_resolved` set to null.

tools.name: delete_function
tools.description: Delete a deployed function from a project.

tools.name: update_function
tools.description: Update a function's schedule, timeout, or memory without re-deploying code. Pass schedule as a cron expression to set/update, or null to remove.

schedule.description: Cron expression (5-field, e.g. '*/15 * * * *') to set or update the schedule. Pass null to remove an existing schedule.

tools.name: set_secret
tools.description: Set a project secret (e.g. STRIPE_SECRET_KEY). Values are write-only and injected as process.env variables in functions. Setting an existing key overwrites it. Use this before deploy, then declare the key with secrets.require.

value.description: Secret value (will be injected as process.env in functions)

tools.name: list_secrets
tools.description: List secret keys for a project. Values and value-derived hashes are never shown; use this only to check which keys are configured.

tools.name: delete_secret
tools.description: Delete a secret from a project.

tools.name: jobs_submit
tools.description: Submit a fixed platform-managed job. The request must match the gateway jobs API shape: job_type, input with input.json, and max_cost_usd_micros. The SDK supplies the required idempotency header.

job_type.description: Fixed platform-managed job type to run

input.json.description: JSON object passed to the managed job runner

input.description: Input files for the managed job

max_cost_usd_micros.description: Hard customer charge ceiling in micro-USD

tools.name: jobs_get
tools.description: Get a managed job run by id.

tools.name: jobs_logs
tools.description: Read recent runner logs for a managed job. Use tail to cap entries and since for an epoch millisecond lower bound.

tail.description: Maximum number of log entries to return

since.description: Only include logs at or after this epoch millisecond timestamp

tools.name: jobs_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running managed job.

tools.name: deploy_site
tools.description: Deploy a static site (HTML/CSS/JS) from inline file bytes. Files are staged to a temp directory, then uploaded via the v1.32 plan/commit transport — only bytes the gateway doesn't already have are PUT. Served at a unique URL via CloudFront. Free with active tier.

project.description: Project ID to link this deployment to

target.description: Deprecated/unsupported: unified deploy v2 does not support deployment target labels. Passing this field returns an error.

encoding.description: Encoding: 'utf-8' (default) for text, 'base64' for binary files

files.description: Array of files to deploy. Must include at least index.html.

tools.name: deploy_site_dir
tools.description: Deploy a static site from a local directory. Walks the tree, hashes each file, and uploads only the bytes the gateway doesn't already have via the v1.32 plan/commit transport. Files named .git, node_modules, or .DS_Store are skipped; symlinks are rejected. Re-deploying an unchanged tree issues no S3 PUTs. Free with active tier.

project.description: Project ID to link this deployment to

dir.description: Local directory to deploy. The SDK walks this directory, hashes each file, and uploads only bytes the gateway doesn't already have via the unified deploy primitive (CAS-backed). Files named .git, node_modules, or .DS_Store are skipped. Symlinks are rejected.

target.description: Deprecated/unsupported: unified deploy v2 does not support deployment target labels. Passing this field returns an error.

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Unified deploy primitive (v1.34+). Accepts a structured ReleaseSpec — database (migrations + expose), value-free secrets.require/delete declarations, functions, site, site.public_paths, subdomains, and routes.replace web routes — with explicit replace vs patch semantics per resource. Use site.public_paths for clean static URLs such as /events backed by release asset events.html; explicit mode does not expose /events.html unless separately declared, while mode: 'implicit' restores filename-derived reachability and can widen access. Route entries map exact/final-wildcard browser paths like /admin and /admin/* to Node 22 Fetch Request -> Response functions, or exact GET/HEAD method-aware static aliases such as /events to { type: 'static', file: 'events.html' }; intentional read-only GET/HEAD wildcard function routes may set acknowledge_readonly: true. Direct /functions/v1/:name remains API-key protected. Secret values must be set first with set_secret, never placed in deploy specs. All bytes ride through CAS (no inline-body cap). Returns release_id, URLs, warnings, and a structured progress-event log. Stops before upload/commit on confirmation-required warnings unless reviewed codes are passed with allow_warning_codes or allow_warnings is true.

project_id.description: Project ID to deploy to (from provision).

base.description: Diff base. Default `{ release: 'current' }`. Use `{ release: 'empty' }` for a fresh deploy that fails if a release already exists.

id.description: Stable migration id (e.g. '001_init'). Same id+checksum across re-deploys is a registry noop; same id+different checksum is a hard error.

sql.description: Inline SQL (UTF-8). Either sql or sql_ref is required.

sql_ref.description: Pre-uploaded CAS reference. Mutually exclusive with sql.

checksum.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the migration SQL. Computed from `sql` if omitted.

zero_downtime.description: Skip the migrate-gate phase. Only safe when migrations are declared backward-compatible.

require.description: Secret keys that must already exist. Set values first with `set_secret`; never put secret values in deploy specs.

contentType.description: MIME type override. Auto-detected from the path's extension when omitted.

source.description: Single-file function source. The SDK uploads it to CAS and references it in the release.

files.description: Multi-file function. Provide `entrypoint` to designate the entry path.

schedule.description: Cron expression (5-field). Pass null to remove an existing schedule; omit in patch mode to leave it unchanged.

mode.description: Restore filename-derived public reachability for static assets.
Use only the complete replace table as direct public static URLs.

asset.description: Release static asset path, such as events.html. This is not a public URL.

cache_class.description: Optional static cache class, for example html, immutable_versioned, or revalidating_asset.

replace.description: Complete map from public browser paths such as /events to release static asset paths such as events.html.

key.description: Asset key (path under the project's asset namespace, no leading slash).

source.description: Source bytes (SDK-input form). Mutually exclusive with sha256.

sha256.description: Pre-uploaded CAS reference (wire form). Mutually exclusive with source.

size_bytes.description: Required when using the wire form (sha256).

put.description: Per-key asset puts. Pass either { source } for the SDK to hash/upload, or { sha256, size_bytes } when bytes are already in CAS.

delete.description: Asset keys to remove in the activation transaction.

prefix.description: Prefix under which sync operates. Required.

prune.description: Must be true to declare destructive sync intent.

confirm.description: Confirmation token echoed back from a prior plan; required to commit a destructive sync.

sync.description: Declarative sync. With prune: true and no confirm, the plan returns an asset_sync block with the values to echo back.

assets.description: v1.48 unified-apply assets slice. Asset writes promote inside the same activation transaction as functions/site/secrets so a release flips atomically.

subdomains.description: At most one subdomain per project — multi-element `set` is rejected with SUBDOMAIN_MULTI_NOT_SUPPORTED.

pattern.description: Route pattern such as /api, /api/*, or /login. Prefix wildcards only use a final /*.

methods.description: Optional method allowlist. Omit to allow all supported methods; do not pass an empty array.

name.description: Materialized release function name, not a file name or handler export.

file.description: Materialized static-site file path, relative to the site root. No leading slash, query, fragment, traversal, or directory shorthand.

acknowledge_readonly.description: Durable acknowledgement for intentional GET/HEAD final-wildcard function routes such as /share/*.

routes.description: Deploy-v2 web routes. Omit or pass null to carry forward base routes; pass { replace: [] } to clear routes; pass { replace: [{ pattern, methods?, target: { type: 'function', name } }] } for functions or exact GET/HEAD { target: { type: 'static', file } } entries for method-aware static route aliases. Prefer site.public_paths for ordinary clean static URLs.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client idempotency key. Combined with the project id and gateway-computed manifest digest to deduplicate retries.

allow_warnings.description: Continue past plan warnings that require confirmation. Default false: the tool stops before upload/commit so an agent can set missing secrets or inspect warnings.

allow_warning_codes.description: Continue past specific reviewed plan warning codes. Prefer this to allow_warnings when only one known warning class is intentional.

tools.name: deploy_diagnose_url
tools.description: Read-only authenticated diagnostics for a Run402 public URL or host/path pair. Explains whether the current live release would serve the URL, including match, diagnostic body status, static manifest/cache metadata when returned, structured warnings for ignored query/fragment, and next steps. This does not fetch bytes, purge cache, mutate deploy state, or expose internal CAS URLs.

project_id.description: Project ID used for local apikey lookup. It is not sent as a query parameter.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) public URL to diagnose. Mutually exclusive with host/path.

host.description: Lower-level hostname form without scheme, path, query, or fragment.

path.description: Lower-level public URL path. Must start with '/' when supplied.

method.description: HTTP method to diagnose. Defaults to gateway behavior when omitted.

tools.name: deploy_resume
tools.description: Resume a deploy operation that ended in `activation_pending` or `schema_settling` (e.g. transient gateway failure between SQL commit and the pointer-swap activation). The gateway re-runs only the failed phase forward — SQL is never replayed. Idempotent: calling on an already-terminal operation returns the snapshot without re-running.

operation_id.description: Operation id returned by a prior `deploy` call. Required.

tools.name: deploy_list
tools.description: List recent deploy operations for a project. Returns operation_id, status, release_id, and timestamps. Use this to build deploy-history UIs or to find a recent operation_id to feed into `deploy_resume` / `deploy_events`. Pass `limit` to bound the result set; the gateway also returns a `cursor` for pagination when there are more.

project_id.description: Project ID to list operations for. Required (apikey-gated).

limit.description: Maximum number of operations to return. Forwarded to the gateway as `?limit=`; the gateway picks a default when omitted.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous deploy_list response. Forwarded to the gateway as `?cursor=`.

tools.name: deploy_events
tools.description: Fetch the recorded phase-event stream for a deploy operation. Returns the same `DeployEvent` shapes the `deploy` tool emits inline during an in-flight deploy — useful for inspecting a deploy after the fact (e.g., a deploy that the agent didn't observe directly, or one being resumed from a different process).

operation_id.description: Operation id returned by a prior `deploy` call. Must start with `op_`.

project_id.description: Project ID that owns the operation. Required (apikey-gated endpoint).

tools.name: deploy_release_get
tools.description: Fetch a release inventory by id. Returns release metadata, effective/desired state kind, site path inventory, function inventory, secret keys, subdomains, and applied migrations. Use `site_limit` to cap large site inventories. Canonical SDK errors are preserved.

project_id.description: Project ID that owns the release.

release_id.description: Release ID to inspect, e.g. rel_...

site_limit.description: Maximum site path entries to include. Gateway default: 5000.

tools.name: deploy_release_active
tools.description: Fetch the current-live release inventory for a project. Returns `release_id: null` with an empty current-live inventory when no release is active yet. Use this before deploy diffs to understand what is currently serving. Canonical SDK errors are preserved.

site_limit.description: Maximum site path entries to include. Gateway default: 5000.

tools.name: deploy_release_diff
tools.description: Diff two release targets for a project. `from` may be `empty`, `active`, or a release id; `to` may be `active` or a release id. Returns release-to-release diff buckets and `migrations.applied_between_releases`. Semantic gateway errors such as invalid targets, same-release diffs, or no active release are preserved.

from.description: Diff source target: empty, active, or a release id.

to.description: Diff target: active or a release id.

limit.description: Maximum entries per site diff bucket. Gateway default: 1000.

tools.name: ci_create_binding
tools.description: Create a GitHub Actions CI/OIDC deploy binding by sending a locally signed delegation to the SDK. This MCP wrapper does not sign or broaden authority; the signed delegation defines the repository/branch or environment, allowed events/actions, and optional route_scopes. Without route_scopes, CI cannot deploy route declarations.

project_id.description: Project ID the CI binding may deploy to.

provider.description: CI provider. V1 supports only github-actions; omitted defaults to github-actions.

subject_match.description: GitHub Actions OIDC subject match, e.g. repo:owner/repo:ref:refs/heads/main.

allowed_actions.description: Allowed CI actions. V1 supports only deploy.

allowed_events.description: Allowed GitHub event names, typically push and workflow_dispatch.

route_scopes.description: Optional route delegation scopes, normalized by the SDK. Use exact paths like /admin or final wildcard prefixes like /api/*. Omit or pass [] for no CI route authority.

github_repository_id.description: Numeric GitHub repository id to pin the binding to, or null if absent.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO timestamp when this binding expires.

nonce.description: Lowercase hex nonce included in the signed delegation.

signed_delegation.description: Base64 SIGN-IN-WITH-X delegation signed locally by the allowance wallet. This MCP tool does not sign; it only sends the signed delegation to the SDK.

tools.name: ci_list_bindings
tools.description: List CI/OIDC deploy bindings for a project, including route_scopes when delegated. Use this to inspect which GitHub Actions subjects can deploy before editing bindings.

project_id.description: Project ID whose CI bindings should be listed.

tools.name: ci_get_binding
tools.description: Get one CI/OIDC deploy binding by id, including its subject, allowed events/actions, repository id, revocation state, and route_scopes.

tools.name: ci_revoke_binding
tools.description: Revoke one CI/OIDC deploy binding. Revocation stops future CI gateway requests, but does not undo already deployed releases or rotate secrets.

binding_id.description: CI binding id to revoke. Revocation stops future CI requests only.

tools.name: claim_subdomain
tools.description: Claim a custom subdomain (e.g. myapp.run402.com) and point it at an existing deployment. Free, requires service_key auth.

name.description: Custom subdomain name (e.g. 'myapp' → myapp.run402.com). 3-63 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens.

deployment_id.description: Deployment ID to point this subdomain at (e.g. 'dpl_1709337600000_a1b2c3')

project_id.description: Optional project ID for ownership tracking. Uses stored service_key for auth.

tools.name: delete_subdomain
tools.description: Release a custom subdomain. The URL will stop serving content.

project_id.description: Optional project ID for ownership verification. Uses stored service_key for auth.

tools.name: list_subdomains
tools.description: List all subdomains claimed by a project.

tools.name: add_custom_domain
tools.description: Register a custom domain (e.g. example.com) to point at a Run402 subdomain. Returns DNS instructions for the human to configure.

domain.description: The custom domain to register (e.g. 'example.com' or 'docs.example.com')

subdomain_name.description: The Run402 subdomain to map this domain to (e.g. 'myapp' for myapp.run402.com)

project_id.description: The project ID that owns the subdomain

tools.name: list_custom_domains
tools.description: List all custom domains registered for a project.

tools.name: check_domain_status
tools.description: Check if a custom domain's DNS is configured and SSL is active. Poll this after registering a domain.

tools.name: remove_custom_domain
tools.description: Release a custom domain mapping. Traffic to the domain will no longer route to Run402.

project_id.description: Optional project ID for ownership verification

tools.name: browse_apps
tools.description: Browse public apps available for forking. Optionally filter by tags.

tools.name: fork_app
tools.description: Fork a published app into a new project. Creates a full copy including database, functions, site, and optionally claims a subdomain.

version_id.description: The app version ID to fork (from browse_apps)

name.description: Name for the new forked project

subdomain.description: Optional subdomain to claim for the forked app

tools.name: publish_app
tools.description: Publish a project as a forkable app. Set visibility and tags for discoverability.

visibility.description: Visibility: public (listed in browse_apps), unlisted (accessible by ID), private (default)

fork_allowed.description: Whether other users can fork this app (default: false)

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List published versions of a project.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get tier pricing for Run402 projects. Free, no auth required. Shows prices, lease durations, storage limits, and API call limits.

tools.name: tier_status
tools.description: Check current tier subscription — tier name, status, expiry, usage, and function authoring caps when returned (max timeout, memory, scheduled functions, min cron interval). Requires allowance auth.

tools.name: set_tier
tools.description: Subscribe, renew, or upgrade tier. Auto-detects action based on allowance state. Returns success or payment details if x402 payment is needed.

tier.description: Target tier — subscribes, renews, or upgrades automatically based on wallet state

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Immediately and irreversibly delete a project: the gateway runs the full destructive cascade (drop tenant schema, delete Lambda functions, release subdomains, tombstone mailbox, remove sender domain, wipe secrets and app versions) and sets status=purged. This tool also removes the project from the local key store. Distinct from the automatic lease-expiry grace window — this action is the explicit purge and cannot be undone. To recover from a missed renewal use `set_tier` instead.

project_id.description: The project ID to delete (irreversible cascade purge)

tools.name: pin_project
tools.description: Pin a project so it is not garbage-collected or expired. Admin only — uses the configured allowance wallet for run402 platform admin auth; project owners authenticating with service_key or a non-admin SIWX wallet will receive 403 admin_required. Not a self-service command for regular users.

project_id.description: The project ID to pin. Admin only — uses the configured allowance wallet for run402 platform admin auth; project owners authenticating with service_key or a non-admin SIWX wallet will receive 403 admin_required.

tools.name: promote_user
tools.description: Promote a user to project_admin role by email. Admins can manage secrets from the browser. Requires service_key.

email.description: Email address of the user to promote to project_admin

tools.name: demote_user
tools.description: Demote a user from project_admin role by email. Reverts to default authenticated role. Requires service_key.

email.description: Email address of the user to demote from project_admin

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check billing account balance for an agent allowance address. Shows available and held funds.

wallet.description: Wallet address (0x...) to check billing balance for

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all active projects for an agent allowance address.

wallet.description: Wallet address (0x...) to list projects for

tools.name: allowance_status
tools.description: Check local agent allowance status — address, network, and funding status.

tools.name: allowance_create
tools.description: Create a new local agent allowance (Base Sepolia testnet). Generates a private key and derives the Ethereum address. Saved to ~/.config/run402/allowance.json.

tools.name: allowance_export
tools.description: Export the local agent allowance address. Safe to share publicly.

tools.name: request_faucet
tools.description: Request free testnet USDC from the Run402 faucet (Base Sepolia). Rate limit: 1 per IP per 24h. Returns 0.25 USDC — enough for 2 prototype databases.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...) to fund. If omitted, reads from local agent allowance file.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate a PNG image from a text prompt. Costs $0.03 USDC via x402. Aspect ratios: square (1:1), landscape (16:9), portrait (9:16).

tools.name: create_mailbox
tools.description: Create a project-scoped email mailbox at <slug>@mail.run402.com. One mailbox per project.

project_id.description: The project ID to create a mailbox for

slug.description: Mailbox slug (3-63 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, no consecutive hyphens). Creates <slug>@mail.run402.com

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from the project's mailbox. Two modes: template (project_invite, magic_link, notification) or raw HTML (subject + html). Optional from_name for display name. Single recipient only.

template.description: Email template (template mode). project_invite, magic_link, or notification

variables.description: Template variables (template mode). project_invite: project_name, invite_url. magic_link: project_name, link_url, expires_in. notification: project_name, message (max 500 chars).

subject.description: Email subject line (raw HTML mode, max 998 chars)

html.description: HTML email body (raw HTML mode, max 1MB)

text.description: Plain text fallback (raw HTML mode, auto-generated from HTML if omitted)

from_name.description: Display name for From header, e.g. "My App" (max 78 chars)

in_reply_to.description: ID of a prior message (typically inbound) to thread this one under. The server uses it to set RFC-822 In-Reply-To and References headers. Usually set via reply flows; leave empty for new threads.

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: List sent emails from the project's mailbox. Shows message ID, template, recipient, status, and timestamp.

limit.description: Max messages to return (server caps at 200)

after.description: Pagination cursor (message id from prior page)

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Get a sent email with details and any replies.

tools.name: get_email_raw
tools.description: Get the raw RFC-822 bytes of an inbound email message, base64-encoded. The decoded bytes are bit-identical to the DKIM-signed original — no parsing, normalization, or CRLF cleanup. Use this for cryptographic verification (DKIM checks, zk-email proofs). Inbound messages only; outbound returns 404. For display/threading, use get_email instead.

message_id.description: The message ID to retrieve raw bytes for (must be an inbound message)

tools.name: get_mailbox
tools.description: Get the project's mailbox info (ID, address, slug). Use to check if a mailbox exists.

tools.name: delete_mailbox
tools.description: Delete the project's mailbox (irreversible — drops all messages and webhook subscriptions). Requires confirm=true. If mailbox_id is omitted, resolves the project's mailbox.

mailbox_id.description: Mailbox ID to delete (mbx_...). If omitted, resolves the project's mailbox from the keystore or via GET /mailboxes/v1.

confirm.description: Must be true. Destructive: deleting a mailbox drops all messages and webhook subscriptions and is irreversible.

tools.name: register_mailbox_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook on the project's mailbox. Receives POST notifications for email events (delivery, bounced, complained, reply_received).

events.description: Events to subscribe to. Valid: delivery, bounced, complained, reply_received

tools.name: list_mailbox_webhooks
tools.description: List all webhooks registered on the project's mailbox.

tools.name: get_mailbox_webhook
tools.description: Get details of a specific webhook by ID.

tools.name: delete_mailbox_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook. Idempotent — succeeds even if already deleted.

tools.name: update_mailbox_webhook
tools.description: Update a webhook's URL and/or events. At least one field required. Events is a full replacement, not a merge.

events.description: New events array (full replacement). Valid: delivery, bounced, complained, reply_received

tools.name: ai_translate
tools.description: Translate text to a target language. Requires service key and active AI Translation add-on. Supports optional source language and context hint.

from.description: Source language (ISO 639-1 code). Auto-detected if omitted

context.description: Context hint for tone/register (max 200 chars, e.g. 'formal business email')

tools.name: ai_moderate
tools.description: Run content moderation on text. Returns flagged status and category scores. Free for all projects, requires service key.

text.description: Text content to check for moderation

tools.name: ai_usage
tools.description: Get AI translation usage for the current billing period — used words, quota, and remaining balance.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the Run402 developers. Requires an active tier.

message.description: Message to send to the Run402 developers

tools.name: set_agent_contact
tools.description: Register agent contact info (name, email, webhook). New or changed emails start operator email reply verification. Free with allowance auth.

email.description: Contact email (optional; new or changed emails start reply verification)

tools.name: get_agent_contact_status
tools.description: Get the current agent contact assurance state: wallet_only, email_pending, email_verified, passkey_pending, or operator_passkey.

tools.name: verify_agent_contact_email
tools.description: Start or resend the operator email reply challenge for the active agent contact email. Does not expose the challenge secret.

tools.name: start_operator_passkey_enrollment
tools.description: Email a short-lived Run402 operator passkey enrollment link to the verified contact email. Requires email_verified.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe checkout URL for your human to fund your agent allowance with a credit card.

tools.name: billing_history
tools.description: View billing transaction history for an agent allowance address.

wallet.description: Wallet address (0x...) to get billing history for

tools.name: update_version
tools.description: Update metadata (description, tags, visibility, fork_allowed) of a published app version.

tools.name: delete_version
tools.description: Delete a published app version.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Inspect a specific published app — details, required secrets, fork pricing.

version_id.description: The version ID of the app to inspect

tools.name: init
tools.description: Set up agent allowance, request faucet funding, and check tier status — single-call bootstrap. Idempotent, safe to re-run.

rail.description: Payment rail: x402 (Base Sepolia, default) or mpp (Tempo Moderato)

tools.name: status
tools.description: Full account snapshot — allowance, billing balance, tier subscription, projects, and active project. Single-call overview.

tools.name: project_info
tools.description: Show local project details — REST URL, keys, site URL, and deployment info. Reads from local keystore only.

tools.name: project_use
tools.description: Set the active/default project in the local keystore.

project_id.description: Project ID to set as active

tools.name: project_keys
tools.description: Get anon_key and service_key for a project from the local keystore.

project_id.description: Project ID to get keys for

tools.name: request_magic_link
tools.description: Send a passwordless login email (magic link) to a project user. Auto-creates the user on first verification. Rate limited per email (5/hr) and per project (by tier).

email.description: Email address to send the magic link to

redirect_url.description: URL to redirect to after clicking the magic link. Must be an allowed origin for this project (localhost, claimed subdomain, or custom domain).

intent.description: Magic-link intent. invite requires the service key and creates trusted invite state.

client_state.description: Optional opaque app state preserved through token verification

tools.name: verify_magic_link
tools.description: Exchange a magic link token for access_token + refresh_token. Creates the user if they don't exist. Token is single-use and expires in 15 minutes.

token.description: The magic link token from the email link URL (?token=...)

tools.name: create_auth_user
tools.description: Create or update a project auth user with the service key. Can set project_admin and optionally send a trusted invite.

email.description: Email address of the auth user to create or update

is_admin.description: Set project_admin status for this user

send_invite.description: Send a trusted invite magic link after creating/updating the user

redirect_url.description: Required when send_invite=true. Must be an allowed project auth redirect origin.

client_state.description: Optional opaque state preserved through trusted invite verification

tools.name: invite_auth_user
tools.description: Create/update a project auth user and send a trusted invite magic link. Requires service_key and an allowed redirect_url.

email.description: Email address of the auth user to invite

redirect_url.description: Allowed auth redirect URL for the invite link

is_admin.description: Set project_admin status before sending the invite

client_state.description: Optional opaque state preserved through invite verification

tools.name: set_user_password
tools.description: Change, reset, or set a user's password. Change: provide current_password + new_password. Reset (via magic link login): just new_password. Set (passwordless user): requires allow_password_set=true on project.

access_token.description: The user's access_token (Bearer token from login)

current_password.description: Current password (required for password change, omit for reset via magic link or initial set)

tools.name: auth_settings
tools.description: Update project auth settings: allow_password_set, preferred_sign_in_method, public_signup, and require_passkey_for_project_admin. Requires service_key.

allow_password_set.description: Allow passwordless users (magic link / OAuth) to set a password. Default: false.

preferred_sign_in_method.description: Project UI hint for the preferred sign-in method.

require_passkey_for_project_admin.description: Require eligible passkey login for project_admin sessions.

tools.name: passkey_register_options
tools.description: Create WebAuthn passkey registration options for the authenticated user.

app_origin.description: Exact app origin for the WebAuthn ceremony

tools.name: passkey_register_verify
tools.description: Verify a browser WebAuthn registration response and store the user's passkey.

response.description: PublicKeyCredential registration response JSON from the browser

tools.name: passkey_login_options
tools.description: Create WebAuthn passkey login options for a project app origin.

app_origin.description: Exact app origin for the WebAuthn ceremony

email.description: Optional email hint. Does not expose allowCredentials.

tools.name: passkey_login_verify
tools.description: Verify a browser WebAuthn assertion and return a normal Run402 auth session.

response.description: PublicKeyCredential assertion response JSON from the browser

tools.name: list_passkeys
tools.description: List the authenticated user's active passkeys.

tools.name: delete_passkey
tools.description: Delete one authenticated-user passkey by id.

tools.name: register_sender_domain
tools.description: Register a custom email sending domain for a project. Returns DNS records (DKIM CNAMEs + SPF/DMARC) to add. Once verified, email sends from your domain instead of mail.run402.com.

domain.description: The domain to register for email sending (e.g., 'kysigned.com')

tools.name: sender_domain_status
tools.description: Check the verification status of a project's custom sender domain. Polls SES for pending domains.

tools.name: remove_sender_domain
tools.description: Remove a project's custom sender domain. Email reverts to sending from mail.run402.com.

tools.name: enable_sender_domain_inbound
tools.description: Enable inbound email on a verified custom sender domain. Replies to <slug>@<your-domain> will route through run402. Requires DKIM-verified domain. Returns the MX record to add to DNS.

domain.description: The custom sender domain to enable inbound on (must be DKIM-verified)

tools.name: disable_sender_domain_inbound
tools.description: Disable inbound email on a custom sender domain. Replies to <slug>@<your-domain> will no longer be delivered.

domain.description: The custom sender domain to disable inbound on

tools.name: create_email_billing_account
tools.description: Create an email-based billing account (Stripe-only, no wallet required). Sends a verification email. Idempotent — duplicate emails return the existing account.

email.description: Email address to create a billing account for (Stripe-only, no wallet)

tools.name: link_wallet_to_account
tools.description: Link a wallet to an existing email billing account, enabling hybrid Stripe + x402 access. Fails if the wallet is already linked elsewhere.

tools.name: tier_checkout
tools.description: Subscribe/renew/upgrade to a run402 tier via Stripe credit card. Alternative to x402 on-chain payment. Supports wallet or email identifier. Returns a Stripe checkout URL.

tier.description: Tier name: prototype ($0.10/7d, free with testnet faucet), hobby ($5/30d), team ($20/30d)

tools.name: buy_email_pack
tools.description: Buy a $5 email pack (10,000 emails, never expire). Pack credits activate when tier daily limit is exhausted AND a custom sender domain is verified. Returns a Stripe checkout URL.

tools.name: set_auto_recharge
tools.description: Enable or disable automatic email pack repurchase when credits drop below a threshold. Requires a saved Stripe payment method.

tools.name: provision_contract_wallet
tools.description: Provision an AWS KMS-backed Ethereum wallet for signing smart-contract write transactions. Private keys never leave KMS. Cost: $0.04/day rental ($1.20/month) plus $0.000005 per contract call. Requires $1.20 in cash credit at creation (30 days of rent). Non-custodial.

chain.description: Which EVM chain. Cost: $0.04/day rental, requires $1.20 in cash credit at creation.

recovery_address.description: Optional 0x-prefixed address for auto-drain on day-90 deletion

tools.name: get_contract_wallet
tools.description: Get a KMS contract wallet's metadata + live native-token balance + USD-micros (Chainlink-cached price).

tools.name: list_contract_wallets
tools.description: List all KMS contract wallets owned by the project, including deleted ones.

tools.name: set_recovery_address
tools.description: Set or clear the optional recovery address used for auto-drain on day-90 deletion of a KMS contract wallet.

recovery_address.description: 0x-prefixed address (or null to clear). Used for auto-drain on day-90 deletion.

tools.name: set_low_balance_alert
tools.description: Set the low-balance threshold (in wei) for a KMS contract wallet. Email alerts fire when the wallet's native balance drops below this threshold.

tools.name: contract_call
tools.description: Submit a smart-contract write call from a KMS wallet. The gateway encodes via viem, signs the digest via AWS KMS, and broadcasts. Idempotent on optional idempotency_key. Cost: chain gas at-cost + $0.000005 KMS sign fee per call.

abi_fragment.description: ABI fragment containing the function definition

value.description: Optional native-token value in wei (decimal string)

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key — same key returns same call_id without re-broadcasting

tools.name: contract_read
tools.description: Read-only smart-contract call (view/pure functions). No signing, no gas, no billing — pure RPC convenience.

abi_fragment.description: ABI fragment containing the view/pure function

tools.name: get_contract_call_status
tools.description: Look up a previously submitted contract call by call_id. Returns lifecycle state (pending/confirmed/failed), block number, gas used, gas cost in USD-micros, receipt, and any error.

tools.name: drain_contract_wallet
tools.description: Drain a KMS contract wallet's entire native-token balance to a destination address. Works on suspended wallets — the safety valve. Cost: chain gas + $0.000005 KMS sign fee.

destination_address.description: Where to send the entire native-token balance. Cost: chain gas + $0.000005 KMS sign fee. Works on suspended wallets.

tools.name: delete_contract_wallet
tools.description: Schedule the KMS key for a contract wallet for deletion (7-day AWS minimum window). Refused if the wallet has on-chain balance ≥ dust — drain first.

wallet_id.description: The KMS contract wallet ID. Schedules KMS key deletion (7-day window). Refused if balance >= dust — drain first.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Reports on the Run402 SERVICE (availability, capabilities, operator, deployment) — not your account. For your account status (allowance, tier, projects), use `status`. Reads public GET /status. No auth, no allowance required.

tools.name: service_health
tools.description: Liveness check for the Run402 SERVICE — not your account. For your account status (allowance, tier, projects), use `status`. Reads public GET /health with per-dependency check results. No auth required.
